scene: Playroom with a clear open floor. Child and Peer stand facing each other, Child at screen-right and Peer at screen-left, with empty hands and room to move in place. Locked 16:9 medium two-shot; movements stay small and in place.

emotion.baseline: Calm, warm and regulated baseline. Both speak at a normal family volume with small, natural facial movements and gestures.
emotion.allowed_shift: Child teaches with playful confidence; Peer copies each step eagerly; both end with light giggles and wiggling fingers, ready to play.
emotion.forbidden: No exaggerated surprise, wide-eyed shock, bouncing, raised voices, impatience, blaming or teasing. Any disappointment, worry or sadness stays mild and brief, and the adult helps things stay steady.

clips.start: Child and Peer stand facing each other with empty hands on the open floor.
clips.action: Child announces his game with proud open arms. Peer scratches his head once while asking; Child wiggles his fingers like little bug legs and mimes running in place.
clips.end: Both stand with hands relaxed, smiling.

clips.start: Both stand with hands relaxed, smiling.
clips.action: Peer freezes mid-gesture like a statue while asking. Child demonstrates the statue pose with stiff arms, then counts on five fingers slowly; Peer wiggles one shoulder while asking his rule question.
clips.end: Child holds up one finger for the rule; Peer waits to hear it.

clips.start: Child holds up one finger for the rule; Peer waits to hear it.
clips.action: Child points at Peer, then at himself, for the caller change. Peer counts the three steps on his fingers and nods; they wiggle their fingers together like bug feet, facing each other, ready to start.
clips.end: Both stand with wiggling fingers and big grins on the open playroom floor.
